concerns.text: The plan produces `statistical_tests.csv` (Phase 6) but does not generate an artifact that conforms to the `aggregate-results.schema.yaml` contract (which expects a combined `groups` and `tests` array). Add a step that aggregates `group_summary.csv` and `statistical_tests.csv` into a single `aggregate_results.{json|yaml|csv}` file and validates it against `aggregate-results.schema.yaml`.
